ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels comprising approximately 92-95% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized scarring and punctate markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary pigmentation is a contiguous dark charcoal field. High-contrast white markings are distributed as scattered punctate dots and stochastic linear streaks across both lobes, with no large solid white contiguous regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible acute V-shaped indentation approximately 45 degrees, with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. Notable large-scale notches located on the medial section of the left lobe and a jagged, stair-step profile on the right lobe distal section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to a sharp upward taper at the distal tips; leading edges exhibit a smooth convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast yellowish-white circular clusters (barnacle colonies) localized specifically on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional white linear tracks (rake marks) covering the majority of both lobes, particularly concentrated in the central-left and central-right regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation/missing tissue on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive overlapping linear rake marks suggesting multi-event scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct protruding barnacle clusters at the tips that alter the 2D geometric silhouette of the fluke's distal points.
